# non-blender-user-response-writer

Purpose: Convert technical Blender workflow findings into plain-language user-facing responses with honest caveats.

Produce stakeholder-friendly outputs that preserve truthfulness, evidence boundaries, and clear next actions.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `evidence-and-handoff` | Role `plain-language-final-response-translator` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- in the final response phase to convert technical findings into plain-language user-facing wording
- after `render-export-evidence` classifies artifact evidence, validators (such as `blender-scene-quality-checker`, `material-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, `composition-quality-checker`, `polycount-budget-checker`) supply pass/warn/fail outcomes, `glb-web-handoff` supplies the handoff summary, and `pre-handoff-verification` gates the handoff
- when translating technical blockers, caveats, and verified/unverified status splits for non-Blender users
- Trigger phrases: "write final user summary", "explain this for non-Blender user", "make this stakeholder-friendly"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success → use `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to render-export-evidence)
- to upgrade Runtime or Artifact truth states → use `blender-scene-quality-checker` (`references/skill-blender-scene-quality-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-scene-quality-checker)
- to classify raw artifact evidence → use `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`; use render-export-evidence)
- to generate technical pass/warn/fail checks → use `blender-scene-quality-checker` (`references/skill-blender-scene-quality-checker.md`; use blender-scene-quality-checker or domain quality checkers)
- to assemble technical GLB/web compatibility summaries → use `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-glb-web-handoff.md`; use glb-web-handoff)
- to gate handoff readiness → use `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`; use pre-handoff-verification)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `verified_workflow_and_evidence_state` (`object`): Final pre-handoff verification gate status, runtime truth state, and artifact truth state
- Required input `deliverable_summary_inputs` (`object`): Technical outputs from scene planners, quality checkers, or handoff packagers to translate
- Optional input `stakeholder_audience_profile` (`string`): Target reader role (product manager, web developer, creative director, end user)
- Output contract: `plain_language_stakeholder_response`, `explicit_runtime_and_artifact_status_block`, `jargon_free_next_steps` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. confirm this skill fits your goal
2. provide required inputs first
3. keep runtime claims evidence-bound
4. follow suggested next-skill handoff

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Never imply runtime success or artifact existence without concrete evidence, never hide blockers, and never drop caveats for readability. Keep Runtime (`Not Run | Attempted | Produced | Verified | Failed`) and Artifact (`Not Run | Not Produced | Produced | Verified | Failed`, default `Not Produced`) truth states strictly downgrade-only — if upstream status language is contradictory, downgrade to safer wording. Keep runtime vocabulary strictly within the 2-path + CLI appendix model. This skill writes final wording only and never executes Python or Blender or replaces upstream evidence, validator, handoff, or gate skills.
- Dumping raw logs or unexplained 3D jargon as final output
- Hiding blockers or dropping caveats for readability
- Upgrading Runtime or Artifact truth states or overclaiming completion
- Executing Python or Blender
- Replacing `render-export-evidence` (evidence classification), validators (`blender-scene-quality-checker`, etc.), `glb-web-handoff` (handoff summary), or `pre-handoff-verification` (handoff gating)
